title: Drop-In Ragdoll
cue: ragdoll for any humanoid: go limp on death, get up
summary: A ragdoll for any humanoid Skeleton3D from one node: bodies sized to the mesh at any scale, joint limits like a body's, hits, settling, and a blend back into animation.
useWhen: A humanoid character must fall limp when it dies, is knocked out, or is thrown, and perhaps get up again afterwards.
avoidWhen: A death animation or a fade-out is enough, or the character is not a humanoid. Hit reactions that keep the character on its feet, such as flinches and staggers, are active-ragdoll's.
